concerns.location: tasks.md:Re-plan note & T005/T007 vs spec.md:FR-004/US-2 vs plan.md:T021
concerns.text: FR-004 and US-2 acceptance scenario 2 mandate Type I error estimation 'by shuffling group labels' on the filtered real datasets; plan T021 designates real-data label shuffling (N=5000) as the PRIMARY FR-004 estimator with simulated-null data (T018) as diagnostic only. Tasks T005/T007 invert this — simulated null data is the sole estimator and real-data label shuffling is never performed — while claiming 'the plan's methodological correction' authorizes it. No spec amendment exists. A task list may not silently rewrite the study's core estimator; either restore real-data label shuffling as primary or amend the spec/plan first.

FR-008 requires the Friedman test as THE test of whether transformation type affects error rates; plan T024 likewise. T009 demotes Friedman to 'a secondary check' and substitutes a binomial GEE model as 'the primary test'. This is a semantic weakening of FR-008 with no documented amendment; the GEE may be added, but Friedman must remain the primary FR-008 test.

T008 excludes the untransformed baseline from aggregated_results.csv and adds a test ENFORCING its absence, but FR-007 requires aggregation 'across all available datasets' and US-3 scenario 1 requires means 'for each transformation-test combination'; the aggregated_result.schema.yaml enum also has no baseline value — the exclusion is a contract-driven narrowing, not a spec-authorized one. Either amend the schema+spec to authorize baseline exclusion or include the baseline in the summary tables.

FR-003 requires the three transformations applied to each continuous variable of the real datasets (US-2 scenario 1 operates on 'a filtered dataset'). T004 produces real-dataset transformation records, but no subsequent task ever runs tests on or aggregates real-dataset transformed values — only simulated data is tested. If the simulated-null methodology is retained, FR-003's real-data deliverable is left dangling; a task must consume/verify the real-dataset transformations or the spec must be amended.

T007 introduces an acceptance band 'within [0.04, 0.06]' for the baseline error rate. SC-002 measures against the nominal α = 0.05; this band appears in neither spec nor plan. Justify it against a documented sampling-error rationale or remove it.

Plan T023 specifies 10,000 bootstrap resamples; T008 specifies ≥2,000 for the same SC-004 CI computation. The reduction directly affects attainability of the ±0.02 half-width target and is unexplained — align the two documents.

FR-001 requires ≥50 datasets total from UCI and OpenML; T002 hard-fails unless ≥60 OpenML AND ≥10 UCI are obtained. Stricter-than-spec is not weakening, but the invented per-source minimums and fatal ConnectionError should be documented as a deliberate margin, not presented as the FR.
α-sweep grids disagree: plan T025 sweeps {0.01, 0.05, 0.10}; T009 sweeps {0.01, 0.02, 0.025, 0.05, 0.075, 0.10}. Pick one grid and align both artifacts.
